manifest.scope: Read-only parse/unit/token dry run over all previously bound 1480 source pages; no embeddings, ranking, index rebuild or Agent task

limits: Passing structural and token checks is not retrieval quality or complete semantic source coverage.
Checks use selected content roots and source DOM code text; unsupported images, mathematical semantics, tables and all possible cross-section conditions are not validated by this audit.
No new index or rankings were produced. Failures are retained rather than skipped or treated as supported.
